roles.name: Clinician
roles.description: The clinician who first takes the history, examines the patient, or gives clinical advice.

roles.name: Clinician2
roles.description: A second clinician who joins the consultation. Use order of appearance to distinguish clinicians.

roles.name: Patient
roles.description: The person receiving care and describing their own symptoms.

roles.name: Patient's Family
roles.description: A relative or companion speaking about the patient.

roles.name: Medical Staff
roles.description: A person handling scheduling, room setup, equipment, or other logistics. Assign clinical discussion to a clinician.

instructions: Identify exactly one patient and at least one clinician. Consultations may include several clinicians. Every person needs substantive evidence from the conversation.
